title: Dev Environment
motto: Your tools shape your thinking. Set them up once, set them up right.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Your tools shape your thinking. Set them up once, set them up right.

steps.title: Why environment matters
cards: You're about to learn AI engineering across 200+ lessons using Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia. If your environment is broken, every lesson becomes a fight against tooling.
Most people skip setup and spend hours on import errors and version conflicts. We install bottom-up once: system → packages → runtimes → AI libraries.

steps.title: Four layers of an AI stack
steps.body: System foundation (OS, git, GPU drivers) supports package managers (uv, pnpm, cargo), which manage language runtimes (Python, Node, Rust), which host AI/ML libraries (PyTorch, transformers). Install bottom-up.

steps.title: Implement environment_layers
